record.title: Decide stock whole-sequence validation from completed private evidence
record.intent: Admit stock validation only after the remaining observer controls have actual guest evidence.
requirements: Distinguish original failed attempts, corrected offline replay and actual guest controls. Reconcile unexpected evidence before any continuation.

If all controls support it, admit a bounded stock validation of the full predicted ADC sequence with unchanged APK and library, the two explicit synthetic logging responses, full thread coverage and unexecuted post-return PC0x333bac. Include preparation and verification tasks as needed; no next-subsystem response is included.
Otherwise identify the smallest supported correction or limitation. Draft, plan, inspect and admit any successor against the current revision and commit and push before implementation.
acceptance: An evidence-supported bounded continuation or precise limitation is committed and pushed.
